name: Ramsey County, MN
findings: Ramsey County has 3,176 nonprofit organizations. 1,657 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,246 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Ramsey County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 173 housing organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 8 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 173 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do housing organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
